 [Merchant] Available sir. 198,000 taka.

 [Merchant] Yes sir confirmed.

It includes one standard DualSense wireless controller and one HDMI cable in the box. Should you require any extra controllers or other accessories, you may purchase them separately at any time, ma'am.

 [Merchant] thank you very much for your cooperation, sir. I have successfully upgraded your order for priority dispatch, and your LG Inverter Refrigerator will arrive tomorrow morning between 8 AM and 10 AM. Should you face any transit issues, feel free to reach us at +880-1711-XXXXXX. Have a wonderful day!

So with delivery added, 5 units come to 7,325 taka and 10 units come to 13,700 taka. Do you have any other questions at all?

[Buyer] so hey there! i'm looking at this lovely Rajshahi silk saree... just a little curious about how to make sure it's the real deal and good quality. can u tell me how to check if it's genuine? also pls share some actual pics so i can see what it really looks like
 [Merchant] Hello! It is so wonderful to hear from you. Please do not worry at all, because we get our Rajshahi silk saree straight from trusted traditional weavers who really know their craft. Every single piece comes with a genuine certification tag so you can check its origin. I will gladly email you some clear, high-res photos taken in different lighting so you can see the gorgeous texture and color properly. Would email work best for you?
 [Buyer] email is perfect thnx... please make sure to include some close ups of the weave pattern and those authenticity tags too if u can
 [Merchant] You got it! I am putting those together for you right now. You will have that email in just a bit with all the close-ups of the weave, multiple angles, and clear shots of the certification labels. Just let me know if there is any other detail you want me to snap for you!
 [Buyer] thanks so much... just one quick question before that, how should i wash and look after it properly? want to make sure i keep it safe
 [Merchant] Of course! Taking proper care is so important to keep your Rajshahi silk saree looking stunning for a long time. Here are some simple care tips: 1. Hand Wash Only: Use cold water and a mild detergent. 2. Avoid Machine Washing: Gentle hand washing keeps the fabric safe. 3. Dry in Shade: Keep it out of direct sunlight so the color stays bright. 4. Ironing: Use a low heat setting with a pressing cloth over the fabric. 5. Storage: Keep it in a cool, dry spot, and try rolling it instead of folding to prevent creases. 6. Stain Removal: Clean any spots right away with a silk-safe mild cleaner. Following these steps will keep your saree looking gorgeous!
